text.en: Absorbing a Remnant strengthens Mark of the Devourer and partially refills the magazine.

Collecting a Remnant grants 'Soul Devourer' for 7 seconds and <title refills [G_refill] /> 4 ammo. 

Collecting additional Remnants can overflow both the timer and magazine, extending the duration up to 11 seconds and the magazine up to 350% capacity (40 rounds).

Soul Devourer increases poison damage by <pve 200% /> <pvp [1750%?] /> while active.
